name: Meeting Attendance Guide
description: Complete checklist and guide for attending public government meetings

countyCouncil.location: Council Chambers, Government Center, 669 Washington St, Easton

items.task: Check the meeting calendar for date, time, and location
Review the agenda (usually posted 24-48 hours before on county website)
If speaking: Sign up for public comment (sometimes required before meeting)
Prepare written notes if giving public comment
Practice your statement with a timer (3 minutes max)
Know parking situation (courthouse garage, street parking)
Arrange childcare if needed (meetings can run 2+ hours)
Photo ID (for courthouse security)
Printed copy of agenda
Notepad and pen
Your prepared comments (if speaking)
Copies of any documents you plan to reference
Phone silenced!
Water bottle (meetings can be long)
Arrive 10-15 minutes early
Find seating in public gallery
Sign in for public comment if required
Sit quietly - no talking during proceedings
No clapping, booing, or outbursts (can get you removed)
Wait to be recognized before speaking
Address the Chair/President, not individual members
Stay on topic and within time limit
Take notes on discussion and votes
Send follow-up email to relevant officials
Review minutes when posted (usually at next meeting)
Share information with neighbors or community groups
Note any next steps or future meeting dates mentioned

do: State your name and address clearly
Thank the officials for their service
Bring facts and evidence to support your position
doNot: Clap, boo, or make noise from the audience

firstTimerTips: Just go to observe! You don't have to speak your first time
Watching helps you understand the process
Notice how experienced speakers present their points
See where public comment fits in the agenda
Get comfortable with the location and format
You can always speak at the next meeting

accessibility.ada: Government meetings must be ADA accessible
accessibility.interpreter: Sign language interpreters available with advance notice
accessibility.assistiveListening: Assistive listening devices may be available
